'''Harkan Resch''' was an independent [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] and prior owner of the ''[[Mystic Burn]]''. Following the [[Blockade/Legends|Blockade]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], he was forced to sell the ship, hoping to make enough to live comfortably for the rest of his life.<ref name="CG1" />
